description: Smart document conversion and processing platform. Supports image/PDF conversion to Word, Excel and Markdown, images to PDF, Word/Excel/PPT to PDF, Office format upgrades (DOC to DOCX), image enhancement (shadow removal, sharpening, HD upscaling, photo restoration), OCR, image translation, formula extraction, watermark processing, multi-image merging, and cloud document saving, search, download, move and folder management.
